facts.text: A manufacturer of heavy off-road machines for construction, mining, quarrying and similar work already sells a system that warns the operator when the machine gets too close to an object.
facts.quote: already sells a system that warns the operator when the machine gets too close to an object.

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine manufacturer is developing a system that automatically applies the brakes if the operator does not react.
facts.quote: It is now developing a system that also applies the brakes automatically if the operator does not react.

facts.text: Prototype hardware and software for the heavy off-road machine automatic braking function will arrive in mid-2027.
facts.quote: Prototype hardware and software will arrive in mid-2027

facts.text: Validation of the heavy off-road machine automatic braking function must finish in less than four months after prototype hardware and software arrive in mid-2027.
facts.quote: Prototype hardware and software will arrive in mid-2027, and validation must then finish in less than four months

facts.text: Past validation of this kind of heavy off-road machine automatic braking function took three to four years of physical testing and tuning for each machine model.
facts.quote: in the past validating this kind of function took three to four years of physical testing and tuning for each machine model.

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine automatic braking function must work across more than 100 types of job site.
facts.quote: The function must work across more than 100 types of job site

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine automatic braking function must work across more than 10 operating scenarios per machine.
facts.quote: more than 10 operating scenarios per machine

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine automatic braking function must work in many weather and light conditions, including rain, snow, fog, dust, dusk, darkness and glare.
facts.quote: many weather and light conditions (rain, snow, fog, dust, dusk, darkness, glare)

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine automatic braking function must work across many machine models with different sizes and sensor positions.
facts.quote: many machine models with different sizes and sensor positions.

facts.text: Sensor types for the heavy off-road machine automatic braking function are not confirmed, so the research had to cover camera, radar, lidar, ultrasonic and other options.
facts.quote: The sensor types are not confirmed, so camera, radar, lidar, ultrasonic and other options all had to be covered.

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine manufacturer's organization currently has no virtual testing capability.
facts.quote: The organization has no virtual testing capability today.

facts.text: The research sought a neutral map of tools and service providers for virtual testing of driver-assistance and autonomy functions, together with the cost of building that capability.
facts.quote: produce a neutral map of the tools and service providers for virtual testing of driver-assistance and autonomy functions, and to learn what it costs to build this capability.

facts.text: The virtual-testing market research was to cover complete simulation platforms, sensor simulation, vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil models, environment creation and reconstruction, scenario generation and test management, data replay and hardware-in-the-loop systems, and cloud execution.
facts.quote: complete simulation platforms, sensor simulation, vehicle and machine dynamics, terrain and soil models, environment creation and reconstruction, scenario generation and test management, data replay and hardware-in-the-loop systems, and cloud execution

facts.text: The virtual-testing market map was to cover commercial products, open-source projects and research tools.
facts.quote: covering commercial products, open-source projects and research tools.

facts.text: For each virtual-testing tool, the research was to identify functionality, whether off-road and heavy-machine support is demonstrated or merely claimed, supported sensor types, interfaces and standards, license model, available public pricing, maturity, known users and the latest release date.
facts.quote: what it does, whether off-road and heavy-machine support is demonstrated or only claimed, sensor types supported, interfaces and standards, license model, public pricing if any, maturity, known users, and the date of the latest release.

facts.text: The virtual-testing research was to identify tools built for, or adapted to, mining, construction, agriculture or forestry.
facts.quote: Which tools were built for, or adapted to, mining, construction, agriculture or forestry?

facts.text: The virtual-testing research was to identify tools commonly combined into a tool chain and the integration work required.
facts.quote: Which tools are commonly combined into one tool chain, and how much integration work does that take?

facts.text: The virtual-testing research was to compare evidence on building in-house, buying or partnering in terms of total cost, time to a first useful result, and required team size and skills.
facts.quote: What is the evidence on building in-house, buying, or working with a partner, comparing total cost, time to a first useful result, and the team size and skills needed?

facts.text: The virtual-testing research was to identify engineering service companies and research institutes offering virtual-testing work as a service.
facts.quote: Which engineering service companies and research institutes offer this work as a service?

facts.text: The virtual-testing research was to identify required computing resources and their costs.
facts.quote: Which computing resources are needed, and what do they cost?

facts.text: The virtual-testing research was to investigate risks involving dependence on one supplier, fast-changing tools, data security and license limits.
facts.quote: What are the risks: dependence on one supplier, fast-changing tools, data security, and license limits?

facts.text: The virtual-testing research was required to remain neutral, favor no vendor, product or technology, and give open-source, commercial, academic and in-house options equal depth.
facts.quote: The research was to stay neutral, favoring no vendor, product or technology, and to give open-source, commercial, academic and in-house options the same depth.

facts.text: Each important claim in the virtual-testing research was to be labeled as independent evidence, the vendor's own claim or expert opinion; independent evidence includes studies, standards, third-party tests or documented customer use.
facts.quote: Each important claim was to be labeled by evidence type (independent study, standard or third-party test or documented customer use; the vendor's own claim; or expert opinion)

facts.text: Marketing claims in the virtual-testing research were to be clearly marked.
facts.quote: with marketing claims marked clearly.

facts.text: Every source in the virtual-testing research was to be dated, with sources from 2024 or later preferred for product features, releases and prices.
facts.quote: Every source was to be dated, with sources from 2024 or later preferred for product features, releases and prices.

facts.text: The virtual-testing research was to report failures, limits and evidence against each tool.
facts.quote: Failures, limits and evidence against each tool were to be reported

facts.text: The virtual-testing research was to flag tools proven only for on-road vehicles.
facts.quote: tools proven only for on-road vehicles were to be flagged

facts.text: Information not found during the virtual-testing research, including prices and timelines, was to be explicitly written as "not found" rather than guessed.
facts.quote: anything not found was to be written as "not found" rather than guessed, including prices and timelines.
